text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After training, Tokai Teio spots Mejiro McQueen still running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio has been training hard herself, and her strength is clearly growing day by day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As such, she has a hard time believing Symboli Rudolf's prediction that she won't be able to beat McQueen again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To fight back against those words, Tokai Teio asks for a scrimmage against Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But just as Symboli Rudolf had warned, the race results in Mejiro McQueen's victory.
